name: 健檢報告異常
intro: 健檢報告出現抗核抗體、類風濕因子、抗CCP抗體陽性或尿酸偏高時，這頁說明它們的意思；是否生病，要由醫師合併症狀與檢查判斷。

cards.title: 抗核抗體陽性
cards.summary: 健康的人也可能陽性，數值越高越少見。
cards.illustration: A calm adult sitting at a kitchen table reading a printed health-check report shown only as blank lines and simple icons, with a cup of tea nearby; flat, friendly style, no text, no numbers, no brands.

points.text: 健康的人也可能驗出抗核抗體（ANA）陽性：1:40以上約20%、最多可達35%，1:160以上約5%。
points.strength_label: CRA 2015・指引說明；ICAP 2019・專家共識

evidence.quote: "With the HEp-2 substrate, about 20% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:40 or higher, while" "5% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:160 or higher."
evidence.strength: CRA Choosing Wisely item (peer-reviewed); supporting text. WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org via WebFetch (matches the evidence agent's two reads))
evidence.confidence: High for the item; Low for the cited PPV figures (PPV figures not used here)

evidence.quote: Indeed, up to 35% of healthy controls may be positive if a screening dilution of 1/40 is used.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement (citing EASI/IUIS, S6) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

points.text: 抗核抗體數值越高（如1:160高於1:40），和自體免疫風濕病關聯越強。

evidence.quote: Indeed, higher antibody levels are better associated with SARD and have an increased likelihood to identify the autoantigen in follow-up testing.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

evidence.quote: For ANA at titers of 1:40, 1:80, 1:160, and 1:320, meta-regression gave sensitivity values of … The corresponding specificities were 66.9% (95% CI 57.8-74.9%), 74.7% (95% CI 66.7-81.3%), 86.2% (95% CI 80.4-90.5%), and 96.6% (95% CI 93.9-98.1%), respectively.
evidence.strength: SR/meta-regression (specificity estimated against comparison groups, not the general population) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 28544593))

evidence.quote: "With the HEp-2 substrate, about 20% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:40 or higher, while" "5% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:160 or higher."
evidence.strength: CRA Choosing Wisely item (peer-reviewed); supporting text. WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org via WebFetch (matches the evidence agent's two reads))
evidence.confidence: High for the item; Low for the cited PPV figures (PPV figures not used here)

points.text: 單看報告上的抗核抗體型態，通常不能確定和哪一種疾病有關，要由醫師配合症狀判斷。

evidence.quote: Altogether, it is evident that, with the exception of the centromere pattern (AC-3), all patterns are to be confirmed by antigen-specific immunoassay for a solid association with the respective autoimmune diseases.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

evidence.quote: 1. Do not test antinuclear antibody (ANA) subserologies without a positive ANA and clinical suspicion of immune-mediated disease
evidence.strength: Grade 1C item; cited here for the point that further antibody testing depends on the doctor's clinical suspicion | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC4106486 (ACR 2013 full text))

points.text: 不同醫院或檢驗所的抗核抗體檢驗方法、陽性切點可能不同，結果不一定一致。
points.strength_label: EASI/IUIS 2014・專家共識；ICAP 2019・專家共識

evidence.quote: These alternative platforms differ in their antigen profiles, sensitivity and specificity, raising uncertainties regarding standardisation and interpretation of incongruent results.
evidence.strength: International consensus recommendations (abstract) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 24126457))

evidence.quote: Therefore, in the EASI/IUIS recommendations, it is advocated that each laboratory verifies that the screening dilution is defined by a cut-off set at the 95th percentile.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement (citing EASI/IUIS, S6) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

tip.text: 沒有相關疾病表現、卻驗出抗核抗體陽性的情況越來越多，可能和真正有病的陽性一樣常見。

evidence.quote: the number of clinically unexpected positive results, that is, positive test results with no clinical evidence of an associated autoimmune disease, is ever increasing and may even equal the likelihood of a clinically true-positive result.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

cards.title: 抗核抗體與紅斑性狼瘡
cards.summary: 抗核抗體陽性只是入門條件，不等於紅斑性狼瘡。
cards.illustration: A doctor and a patient talking at a desk; beside them, a simple drawing of an open door with a few blank puzzle pieces beyond it, suggesting that one test is only a first step; flat, friendly style, no text.

points.text: 國際紅斑性狼瘡分類標準中，抗核抗體陽性（1:80以上）只是入門條件。

evidence.quote: The 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria for SLE include positive ANA at least once as obligatory entry criterion; … They endorsed “positive ANA (≥1:80 by HEp-2 immunofluorescence)” as an entry criterion.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

evidence.quote: ANAs at a titer of 1:80 have sufficiently high sensitivity to be considered as an entry criterion for SLE classification criteria, i.e., formally test other classification criteria for SLE only if ANAs of at least 1:80 have been found.
evidence.strength: SR/meta-regression | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 28544593))

points.text: 通過入門條件後，還要依7類臨床表現（例如皮膚黏膜、肌肉骨骼、腎臟）和3類免疫檢驗評分，累積10分以上，才歸類為紅斑性狼瘡。

evidence.quote: The 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria for SLE include positive ANA at least once as obligatory entry criterion; followed by additive weighted criteria grouped in 7 clinical (constitutional, hematologic, neuropsychiatric, mucocutaneous, serosal, musculoskeletal, renal) and 3 immunological (antiphospholipid antibodies, complement proteins, SLE-specific antibodies) domains, and weighted from 2 to 10. Patients accumulating ≥10 points are classified.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

points.text: 在紅斑性狼瘡分類標準中，每一項表現都要在沒有其他更可能的原因時，才能算分。

evidence.quote: The concept that all criteria are only to be counted if SLE is thought to be the most likely cause of the manifestation (i.e. no other more likely cause exists) is central to these new EULAR/ACR criteria, and is explicitly stated as an overarching principle.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR); overarching principle | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

points.text: 分類標準不是設計來診斷或決定治療的；是否為紅斑性狼瘡，要由受過適當訓練的醫師評估個人狀況來判斷。

evidence.quote: However, it is important to stress that classification criteria are not designed for diagnosis or treatment decisions (). … Diagnosis of SLE remains the purview of an appropriately trained physician evaluating an individual patient ().
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

tip.text: 抗核抗體被當成入門條件，考量之一是：紅斑性狼瘡患者幾乎都會陽性，但沒有這個病的人也可能陽性。

evidence.quote: Such an approach was thought to reflect underlying SLE pathogenesis, and take into account ANA test characteristics of high sensitivity and limited specificity.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

evidence.quote: In the phase 1 early SLE cohort, 99.5% of the 389 SLE patients were ANA positive (). … Using ANA as entry criterion means the new criteria cannot classify SLE among patients who are persistently ANA negative.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

cards.title: 類風濕因子與抗CCP
cards.summary: 陽性不等於類風濕性關節炎；分類標準要求關節腫脹。
cards.illustration: A doctor gently examining a patient's hand at a clinic desk, with a capped blood-test tube resting on the desk; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 類風濕因子（RF）陽性，不一定是類風濕性關節炎；沒有這個病的人也可能驗出陽性。

evidence.quote: The pooled sensitivity, specificity, and positive and negative likelihood ratios for anti-CCP antibody were 67% (95% CI, 62% to 72%), 95% (CI, 94% to 97%), 12.46 (CI, 9.72 to 15.98), and 0.36 (CI, 0.31 to 0.42), respectively. For IgM RF, the values were 69% (CI, 65% to 73%), 85% (CI, 82% to 88%), 4.86 (CI, 3.95 to 5.97), and 0.38 (CI, 0.33 to 0.44).
evidence.strength: Meta-analysis (37 anti-CCP and 50 RF studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 17548411))

evidence.quote: RF may also be elevated in healthy individuals, as well as in scenarios such as infection and malignancy.
evidence.strength: CRA Pediatric Committee Choosing Wisely (peer-reviewed); general background statement. POPULATION: children. This sentence came from a single WebFetch read | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org First Release PDF via WebFetch (now two independent reads))
evidence.confidence: High (item 4 read twice; other quotes single read)

evidence.quote: Autoantibody screening revealed rheumatoid factor (RF), antinuclear antibody (ANA), anti-Ro antibody, and anti-La antibody positivity in 20.8%, 23.4%, 13.0%, and 2.6% of the patients, respectively.
evidence.strength: Cross-sectional (77 patients with hepatitis C infection, northern Taiwan); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 37055257))

points.text: 沒有類風濕性關節炎的人，抗CCP抗體陽性的機會比類風濕因子低。

evidence.quote: The pooled sensitivity, specificity, and positive and negative likelihood ratios for anti-CCP antibody were 67% (95% CI, 62% to 72%), 95% (CI, 94% to 97%), 12.46 (CI, 9.72 to 15.98), and 0.36 (CI, 0.31 to 0.42), respectively. For IgM RF, the values were 69% (CI, 65% to 73%), 85% (CI, 82% to 88%), 4.86 (CI, 3.95 to 5.97), and 0.38 (CI, 0.33 to 0.44). … Anti-CCP antibodies are more specific than RF for diagnosing rheumatoid arthritis
evidence.strength: Meta-analysis (37 anti-CCP and 50 RF studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 17548411))

evidence.quote: Anti-CCP2 had greater specificity than rheumatoid factor (96% vs. 86%), with similar sensitivity.
evidence.strength: SR (151 studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 20368651))

points.text: 類風濕性關節炎的分類標準，要先有至少1個關節腫脹（經專業評估），且沒有其他疾病更能解釋，才能套用。

evidence.quote: "The classification criteria can be applied to any patient or otherwise healthy individual," "as long as two mandatory requirements are met: first, there must be evidence of currently active clinical synovitis" "(ie, swelling) in at least one joint as determined by an expert assessor (table 3)." … "Second, the criteria may be applied only to those patients in whom the observed synovitis" "is not better explained by another diagnosis (table 3)."
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (ACR/EULAR). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; 'at least one joint' also in the PubMed abstract)

points.text: 類風濕因子或抗CCP抗體陰性，也不能排除類風濕性關節炎：研究中，每種抗體都有3成以上的患者是陰性。

evidence.quote: The pooled sensitivity, specificity, and positive and negative likelihood ratios for anti-CCP antibody were 67% (95% CI, 62% to 72%), 95% (CI, 94% to 97%), 12.46 (CI, 9.72 to 15.98), and 0.36 (CI, 0.31 to 0.42), respectively. For IgM RF, the values were 69% (CI, 65% to 73%), 85% (CI, 82% to 88%), 4.86 (CI, 3.95 to 5.97), and 0.38 (CI, 0.33 to 0.44).
evidence.strength: Meta-analysis (37 anti-CCP and 50 RF studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 17548411))

evidence.quote: In cohort studies that investigated second-generation anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibodies (anti-CCP2) in patients with early rheumatoid arthritis (<2 years), summary sensitivity and specificity were 57% (95% CI, 51% to 63%) and 96% (CI, 93% to 97%), respectively.
evidence.strength: SR (151 studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 20368651))

evidence.quote: "Refer urgently (even with a normal acute-phase response, negative anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide" "[CCP] antibodies or rheumatoid factor) if any of the following apply:"
evidence.strength: NICE recommendation 1.1.1 (directive wording; no grade). WebFetch | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (nice.org.uk recommendation 1.1.1 via WebFetch)

tip.text: 類風濕性關節炎的分類標準主要是為研究而訂，不是診斷標準。

evidence.quote: "The working group has deliberately labelled these criteria as ‘classification criteria’" "as opposed to ‘diagnostic criteria’." … "The aim is to provide a standardised approach for discriminating, from a population of individuals" "presenting with undifferentiated synovitis, the subgroup with the highest probability of persistent or erosive RA," "who may be enrolled into clinical trials and other studies through the use of uniform criteria."
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (ACR/EULAR). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; 'at least one joint' also in the PubMed abstract)

cards.title: 抗核抗體不是篩檢工具
cards.summary: 沒有特定症狀時，不建議用抗核抗體篩檢。
cards.illustration: A thoughtful adult at a health-check counter looking at a simple menu of optional blood tests drawn only as blank icons; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 沒有紅斑性狼瘡或其他結締組織疾病的特定症狀或徵象時，不建議把抗核抗體當成篩檢。

evidence.quote: "Do not order antinuclear antibodies (ANA) as a screening test in patients without specific signs or" "symptoms of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or another connective tissue disease (CTD)"
evidence.strength: CRA Choosing Wisely item 1 (peer-reviewed; ungraded 'Do not' item). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org via WebFetch (matches the evidence agent's two reads))
evidence.confidence: High for the item; Low for the cited PPV figures (PPV figures not used here)

points.text: 醫師評估後不懷疑免疫疾病時，即使抗核抗體陽性，也不建議再加驗相關的特定抗體。

evidence.quote: 1. Do not test antinuclear antibody (ANA) subserologies without a positive ANA and clinical suspicion of immune-mediated disease … Grade 1C. … classifies recommendations as strong (grade 1) or weak (grade 2) … the quality of evidence as high (grade A), moderate (grade B), or low (grade C)
evidence.strength: Grade 1C (strong recommendation; low-quality evidence, per the paper's modified GRADE). Adult list; 'meant to leave room for clinical judgment' | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC4106486 (ACR 2013 full text))

points.text: 檢查結果不會改變處理方式，或生病機會低到偽陽性比真陽性更可能時，就不建議檢查。

evidence.quote: This suggestion follows from several principles regarding use of diagnostic tests, including that tests should not be performed if results will not change management or if the pretest probability of disease is low enough to raise the likelihood of a false-positive test higher than the likelihood of a true-positive result.
evidence.strength: Supporting text for Grade 1C item (ACR text) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC4106486 (ACR 2013 full text))

points.text: 沒有方向、範圍很廣的檢查，可能增加偽陽性，帶來不必要的追加檢查和擔心。

evidence.quote: However, newer testing may complicate patient care if it results in undirected or very broad testing that increases false-positive results, leading to unnecessary followup tests and patient concern.
evidence.strength: Supporting text for Grade 1C item (ACR text) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC4106486 (ACR 2013 full text))

cards.title: 尿酸高但沒有痛風
cards.summary: 尿酸高是痛風的危險因子，但不等於痛風。
cards.illustration: A calm adult walking outdoors in comfortable shoes, with a small capped blood-test tube icon floating beside them; flat, friendly style, no text, no numbers.

points.text: 血中尿酸偏高，但從沒有痛風發作，也沒有痛風石，稱為無症狀高尿酸血症。

evidence.quote: Recommendations in this guideline apply to patients with gout, except for a single recommendation regarding the use of ULT in individuals with asymptomatic hyperuricemia, which is defined as an SU concentration of ≥6.8 mg/dl with no prior gout flares or subcutaneous tophi.
evidence.strength: Definition (text says ≥6.8 mg/dl; S33 Table 1 says >6.8 mg/dl) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC10563586 (machine-checked))

points.text: 尿酸高是發生痛風的重要危險因子，但不能只憑尿酸高就診斷痛風。
points.strength_label: EULAR 2018・指引說明；G-CAN 2019・專家共識

evidence.quote: "The diagnosis of gout should not be made on the presence of hyperuric a emia alone." … "Therefore, hyperuricaemia alone should be considered solely as a strong risk factor for incident gout" "and not as a surrogate marker for its diagnosis."
evidence.strength: Recommendation 4; LoE/SoR/LoA not found in accessible text (spacing 'hyperuric a emia' as in the source). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; Rec 4 also in the PubMed abstract)

evidence.quote: There was consensus agreement that the label ‘gout’ should be restricted to current or prior clinically evident disease caused by monosodium urate crystal deposition.
evidence.strength: Consensus (≥80% agreement) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC7288724 abstract)

points.text: 國外研究顯示，尿酸超過9 mg/dL的人，5年內約2成發生痛風；超過10 mg/dL的人，15年內約一半。
points.strength_label: ACR 2020・指引說明；EULAR 2018・指引說明

evidence.quote: From observational studies, among patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia with SU concentrations of >9 mg/dl, only 20% went on to develop gout within 5 years ().
evidence.strength: Supporting text for the asymptomatic-hyperuricaemia recommendation | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC10563586 (machine-checked))

evidence.quote: "For instance, only 22% of asymptomatic patients with SUA levels above 9 mg/dL developed incident gout over a 5-year period." … "For instance, a recent study found that only half of patients with SUA levels above 10 mg/dL" "will develop gout over 15 years."
evidence.strength: Text supporting Recommendation 4. WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; Rec 4 also in the PubMed abstract)

evidence.quote: With urate levels of 9 mg/dl or higher, cumulative incidence of gouty arthritis reached 22 percent after five years.
evidence.strength: Prospective cohort: 2046 initially healthy men, Normative Aging Study (US), 1987. Threshold '9 mg/dl or higher'. Cited only as a second citation showing that the data come from abroad (men only) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: the figure and the US population were checked against the PubMed abstract (PMID 3826098; US men); this exact sentence was not quoted by the fact-check (the evidence agent machine-checked it against the abstract)

evidence.quote: Nonetheless, only about half of those with serum urate concentrations ≥10mg/dL develop clinically evident gout over 15 years, implying a role for prolonged hyperuricaemia and additional factors in the pathogenesis of gout.
evidence.strength: Individual participant data analysis of 4 US cohorts (ARIC, CARDIA, Framingham; n=18 889). Threshold ≥10 mg/dL. Cited only as a second citation showing that the data come from abroad | Fact-check 2026-10-10: the figure and the US population were checked against the PubMed abstract (PMID 29463518); this exact sentence was not quoted by the fact-check (the evidence agent machine-checked it against the abstract)

tip.text: 「偏高」沒有全球統一的數字：美國指引以6.8 mg/dL為界，國際專家共識則沒有訂出單一數字。
tip.strength_label: ACR 2020・指引說明；G-CAN 2019・專家共識

evidence.quote: Recommendations in this guideline apply to patients with gout, except for a single recommendation regarding the use of ULT in individuals with asymptomatic hyperuricemia, which is defined as an SU concentration of ≥6.8 mg/dl with no prior gout flares or subcutaneous tophi.
evidence.strength: Definition (text says ≥6.8 mg/dl; S33 Table 1 says >6.8 mg/dl) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC10563586 (machine-checked))

evidence.quote: For ‘hyperuric(a)emia’, it was considered beyond the scope of this nomenclature project to include a specific threshold of blood urate concentration in its definition. … Therefore, the final accepted definition was modified to read ‘an elevated blood urate concentration over the saturation threshold’.
evidence.strength: Consensus (≥80% agreement) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6252290 (full text))

evidence.quote: Hyperuricemia, defined by elevated concentration of serum urate (SU) exceeding the saturation threshold of 420 μmol/L (7 mg/dL), is a primary risk factor for the development of gout.
evidence.strength: Text statement (Introduction) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC12280528 (full text))

cards.title: 尿酸高要吃藥嗎？
cards.summary: 是否用藥各國標準不同，並非每個人都需要。
cards.illustration: A patient and a family doctor talking at a clinic desk, with a simple plate of mixed vegetables and a pair of walking shoes in the background; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands, no pills.

points.text: 沒有痛風的高尿酸要不要吃降尿酸藥，各國指引看法不同，並不是每個人都需要。
points.strength_label: ACR 2020・不建議；中國指引 2024・指引說明

evidence.quote: Initiating ULT is conditionally recommended against in patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia.
evidence.strength: Conditional (against); certainty of evidence High (S33 Table 1). Direction confirmed from the co-published version because the PMC text of S32 drops 'against'. WebFetch; two reads | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (Deep Blue PDF art41247 via WebFetch, text and Table 1; direction also corroborated by S40, MDedge and the S32 rationale)

evidence.quote: Patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia and SU ≥ 9 mg/dL, or those with comorbidities such as cardiovascular, metabolic dysfunction, and kidney diseases, should initiate ULT as per the 2019 Guideline [].
evidence.strength: Text statement referring to the 2019 guideline (no grade attached to this sentence) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC12280528 (full text))

evidence.quote: "Considering the use of ULA at SUA ≥9 mg/dL and target to SUA ≤6 mg/dL" … "In patients with a SUA ≥8 mg/dL who have complications such as CKD, hypertension, heart failure etc.," "treatment with ULAs should be considered after life-style modifications."
evidence.strength: As reported by a secondary source for the Japanese guideline (3rd ed.); no grade stated for these rows. WebFetch | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (J-STAGE html via WebFetch)

points.text: 調整生活型態（例如飲食和運動）是處理高尿酸和痛風的基礎。
points.strength_label: 香港風濕病學會 2023・指引說明

evidence.quote: Finally, lifestyle modification is a cornerstone in the management of hyperuricemia and gout, and relevant patient education regarding diet and exercise should be espoused when treating these patients.
evidence.strength: Consensus document text (Discussion; not a numbered statement). This sentence is NOT in the evidence file: it is quoted from the independent fact-check (verify_labs.md, 2026-10-10), which read it verbatim in PMC10345000
evidence.confidence: High (verified in PMC full text by the fact-check)

points.text: 多數情況下，高尿酸可以在基層醫療（如家庭醫師）處理；一般治療效果不好時，可能需要轉介專科。
points.strength_label: 香港風濕病學會 2023・指引說明

evidence.quote: In most cases, gout and hyperuricemia can be managed in the primary care setting. Patients who are refractory to standard care may require specialist management and should be referred as and when necessary.
evidence.strength: Consensus document text (Discussion; not a numbered statement) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC10345000 (full text))

tip.text: 要不要用藥，請和醫師討論個人狀況；已經在吃降尿酸藥的人，不要自行停藥。

evidence.strength: Editorial safety phrase (「要不要用藥，請和醫師討論個人狀況；已經在吃降尿酸藥的人，不要自行停藥」, added because the page says not everyone needs medicine; first clause added after the fact-check); not from a source

myths.belief: 抗核抗體陽性，就是得了紅斑性狼瘡。
myths.fact: 不一定。以1:40檢驗，健康的人約20%、最多35%會陽性；抗核抗體只是紅斑性狼瘡分類的入門條件，診斷要由醫師評估。
myths.strength_label: CRA 2015・指引說明；ICAP 2019・專家共識；EULAR/ACR 2019・指引說明

evidence.quote: "With the HEp-2 substrate, about 20% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:40 or higher, while" "5% of normal people have an ANA titer of 1:160 or higher."
evidence.strength: CRA Choosing Wisely item (peer-reviewed); supporting text. WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org via WebFetch (matches the evidence agent's two reads))
evidence.confidence: High for the item; Low for the cited PPV figures (PPV figures not used here)

evidence.quote: Indeed, up to 35% of healthy controls may be positive if a screening dilution of 1/40 is used.
evidence.strength: Consensus statement (citing EASI/IUIS, S6) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6585284 (ICAP full text))

evidence.quote: The 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria for SLE include positive ANA at least once as obligatory entry criterion; … They endorsed “positive ANA (≥1:80 by HEp-2 immunofluorescence)” as an entry criterion.
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

evidence.quote: Diagnosis of SLE remains the purview of an appropriately trained physician evaluating an individual patient ().
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (EULAR/ACR) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC6827566 (Aringer 2019 full text))

myths.belief: 類風濕因子陽性，就是得了類風濕性關節炎。
myths.fact: 不一定。沒有這個病的人也可能陽性；國際分類標準規定，至少要有1個關節腫脹才能套用，單靠抽血不行。
myths.strength_label: ACR/EULAR 2010・指引說明；Nishimura 2007・研究顯示

evidence.quote: "The classification criteria can be applied to any patient or otherwise healthy individual," "as long as two mandatory requirements are met: first, there must be evidence of currently active clinical synovitis" "(ie, swelling) in at least one joint as determined by an expert assessor (table 3)." … "Second, the criteria may be applied only to those patients in whom the observed synovitis" "is not better explained by another diagnosis (table 3)."
evidence.strength: Classification criteria (ACR/EULAR). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; 'at least one joint' also in the PubMed abstract)

evidence.quote: The pooled sensitivity, specificity, and positive and negative likelihood ratios for anti-CCP antibody were 67% (95% CI, 62% to 72%), 95% (CI, 94% to 97%), 12.46 (CI, 9.72 to 15.98), and 0.36 (CI, 0.31 to 0.42), respectively. For IgM RF, the values were 69% (CI, 65% to 73%), 85% (CI, 82% to 88%), 4.86 (CI, 3.95 to 5.97), and 0.38 (CI, 0.33 to 0.44).
evidence.strength: Meta-analysis (37 anti-CCP and 50 RF studies); abstract | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PubMed abstract (PMID 17548411))

evidence.quote: RF may also be elevated in healthy individuals, as well as in scenarios such as infection and malignancy.
evidence.strength: CRA Pediatric Committee Choosing Wisely (peer-reviewed); general background statement. POPULATION: children. This sentence came from a single WebFetch read | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (jrheum.org First Release PDF via WebFetch (now two independent reads))
evidence.confidence: High (item 4 read twice; other quotes single read)

myths.fact: 不是。尿酸高是痛風的重要危險因子，但不能只憑它診斷痛風；國外研究中，尿酸超過9 mg/dL的人，5年內約2成發生痛風。
myths.strength_label: EULAR 2018・指引說明；ACR 2020・指引說明

evidence.quote: "The diagnosis of gout should not be made on the presence of hyperuric a emia alone." … "Therefore, hyperuricaemia alone should be considered solely as a strong risk factor for incident gout" "and not as a surrogate marker for its diagnosis."
evidence.strength: Recommendation 4; LoE/SoR/LoA not found in accessible text (spacing 'hyperuric a emia' as in the source). WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch; Rec 4 also in the PubMed abstract)

evidence.quote: From observational studies, among patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia with SU concentrations of >9 mg/dl, only 20% went on to develop gout within 5 years ().
evidence.strength: Supporting text for the asymptomatic-hyperuricaemia recommendation | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC10563586 (machine-checked))

evidence.quote: There was consensus agreement that the label ‘gout’ should be restricted to current or prior clinically evident disease caused by monosodium urate crystal deposition.
evidence.strength: Consensus (≥80% agreement) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC7288724 abstract)

evidence.quote: With urate levels of 9 mg/dl or higher, cumulative incidence of gouty arthritis reached 22 percent after five years.
evidence.strength: Prospective cohort: 2046 initially healthy men, Normative Aging Study (US), 1987. Threshold '9 mg/dl or higher'. Cited only as a second citation showing that the data come from abroad (men only) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: the figure and the US population were checked against the PubMed abstract (PMID 3826098; US men); this exact sentence was not quoted by the fact-check (the evidence agent machine-checked it against the abstract)

myths.belief: 尿酸高，就一定要吃降尿酸藥。
myths.fact: 不一定。沒有痛風的高尿酸要不要用藥，各國指引看法不同，並不是每個人都需要；已在用藥的人請先和醫師討論，不要自行停藥。
myths.strength_label: ACR 2020・不建議；中國指引 2024・指引說明

evidence.quote: Initiating ULT is conditionally recommended against in patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia.
evidence.strength: Conditional (against); certainty of evidence High (S33 Table 1). Direction confirmed from the co-published version because the PMC text of S32 drops 'against'. WebFetch; two reads | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (Deep Blue PDF art41247 via WebFetch, text and Table 1; direction also corroborated by S40, MDedge and the S32 rationale)

evidence.quote: Patients with asymptomatic hyperuricemia and SU ≥ 9 mg/dL, or those with comorbidities such as cardiovascular, metabolic dysfunction, and kidney diseases, should initiate ULT as per the 2019 Guideline [].
evidence.strength: Text statement referring to the 2019 guideline (no grade attached to this sentence) | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (PMC12280528 (full text))

evidence.quote: "Considering the use of ULA at SUA ≥9 mg/dL and target to SUA ≤6 mg/dL" … "In patients with a SUA ≥8 mg/dL who have complications such as CKD, hypertension, heart failure etc.," "treatment with ULAs should be considered after life-style modifications."
evidence.strength: As reported by a secondary source for the Japanese guideline (3rd ed.); no grade stated for these rows. WebFetch | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (J-STAGE html via WebFetch)
Editorial safety phrase (「已在用藥的人請先和醫師討論，不要自行停藥」); not from a source

seek_care.text: 關節腫脹，而且會痛或僵硬時，建議在症狀開始後6週內看風濕科醫師。

evidence.quote: "Patients presenting with arthritis (any joint swelling, associated with pain or stiffness)" "should be referred to, and seen by, a rheumatologist, within 6 weeks after the onset of symptoms." … "The strength of this recommendation was considered 'good' (category B) (table 1)."
evidence.strength: Recommendation 1; strength of recommendation B ('good'); level of evidence not found in accessible text. WebFetch; read twice | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (ard.bmj.com via WebFetch (matches the evidence agent's two reads))

seek_care.text: 關節持續腫脹，應請專科醫師評估；如果手腳小關節腫、不只一個關節腫，或症狀已3個月以上還沒看醫師，即使類風濕因子或抗CCP抗體陰性，也應盡快評估。

evidence.quote: "Refer for specialist opinion any adult with suspected persistent synovitis of undetermined cause." … "Refer urgently (even with a normal acute-phase response, negative anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide" "[CCP] antibodies or rheumatoid factor) if any of the following apply:" … "the small joints of the hands or feet are affected" … "more than one joint is affected" … "there has been a delay of 3 months or longer between onset of symptoms and seeking medical advice."
evidence.strength: NICE recommendation 1.1.1 (directive wording; no grade). WebFetch | Fact-check 2026-10-10: verified in the original (nice.org.uk recommendation 1.1.1 via WebFetch)

seek_care.text: 對報告有疑問，可以帶著報告和醫師討論。

evidence.strength: Editorial safety phrase (「對報告有疑問，可以帶著報告和醫師討論」, proposed by the writer and supported by the fact-check; no source states when to see a doctor for an abnormal result without symptoms); not from a source
